quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 2,512,750,568.08, up 16.64% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 362,756,609.66, up 9.36%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 360,987,143.74, up 12.54%; net profit excluding share-based payment RMB 390,266,309.66, up 17.65%; operating cash flow RMB 455,673,130.71, up 36.78%. Administrative expenses rose 36.86% on share-based payment and intermediary fees for the acquisition of Australia's SDI; finance costs rose on exchange losses.

Segments (half-year report, H1 2026): electronic materials RMB 382,373,401.80, up 11.03%, gross margin 37.62% (up 4.65 points); catalytic materials RMB 488,041,952.81, up 7.02%, gross margin 44.36%; biomedical (dental) materials RMB 534,194,159.40, up 21.96%, gross margin 49.79%; new energy materials RMB 339,239,415.00, up 56.48%, gross margin 34.72%; digital printing and other materials RMB 575,575,055.04, up 18.40%, gross margin 26.27% (down 11.68 points).
quarterly_data.figure: Electronic materials RMB 382,373,401.80 (+11.03%), gross margin 37.62% (+4.65 points)

quarterly_data.signal: Electronic materials (half-year report): helped by the downstream demand recovery and fast demand growth from AI servers and automotive electronics, sales volumes of MLCC dielectric powders and electronic pastes grew rapidly in H1 2026. The company focused on AI-server and automotive-grade MLCC dielectric powders, developing and validating products, and pushed capacity expansion of these powders - part of the expanded capacity has been completed. MLCC electronic paste volume and revenue grew rapidly, with new high-capacitance, automotive-grade and RF pastes co-developed with customers.

Precision ceramics (half-year report): subsidiary Guoci Saichuang's LED substrates kept gaining share at leading international customers with good volume growth; its ceramic packages, mainly for low-earth-orbit satellite RF chip packaging, are in continuous stable delivery; its thermoelectric cooler (TEC) business worked closely with international customers on product validation in H1. Subsidiary Shenzhen Aierchuang New Materials makes ceramic sleeves, ferrules and other precision structural parts used mainly in high-speed optical modules and fiber transmission, semiconductors and consumer electronics, covering the chain from powder forming and sintering to precision machining.

Construction in progress (half-year report): RMB 435,116,648.23 at June 30, 2026 (RMB 365,638,003.50 at end-2025), of which equipment being installed RMB 266,496,012.48. Major projects: ceramic circuit board project plant No. 2 RMB 67,904,422.26; East China precision ceramics project phase 1 plant RMB 61,114,068.90; plant for the 60,000-tonne-a-year high-end organic composite coating materials project RMB 34,811,069.13; phase-2 rooftop distributed PV project RMB 41,130,275.23 (no budget or completion date stated). Investing cash outflow rose on higher fixed-asset investment (net investing cash flow RMB -415,783,533.05); investment in the period RMB 417,342,173.07, up 109.71%.

Raised-fund projects (half-year report): all projects of the 2020 private placement are complete and the accounts closed (surplus RMB 303.81 ten-thousand moved to working capital, approved January 26, 2026). The ultra-micro chip MLCC dielectric materials R&D and industrialisation project (RMB 20,000 ten-thousand, fully invested, ready for use May 31, 2023) is among them. R&D spend in H1 2026 RMB 164,975,659.15, up 15.35%.
